verdicts.reason: A puts the SOLSTICE wordmark under the headline and crams the body copy into tiny two-line text next to the pills, leaving the left third as empty decoration. B keeps the headline, brand and body copy legible in one clean block with a strong CTA. Its flavour pills, though, are stacked in a column over the decorative circle, with odd ordering and small type.

A scatters the three flavour pills around the CTA (Blood Orange perched above, Honey to the left, Cucumber jammed on the right edge over the circle), which breaks grouping and crowds the button. B keeps the pills in one row, but its body copy is tiny and wrapped beside them, the wordmark sits below the headline, and the left area is dead space.

A's text block and CTA are clean, but the pills in the top-left overlap one another, and Honey Rosemary is shrunk to illegible text over the circle, a clear collision. B has no collisions, but its body copy is tiny and wrapped, the wordmark sits under the headline, and the left side is empty.

A shrinks the CTA to an unreadable micro-pill in the bottom-right, so the main action is lost, and the flavour pills sit as a loose cluster over the circle. B keeps a prominent CTA and a readable headline, though its body copy is tiny and crammed beside the pills and the wordmark sits below the headline.
